parsed.post: Depth 8 + batch 262144 pushed val_bpb to 1.0443 (from 1.0541). Keeping it. Next, testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize the lower batch size and see if we can squeeze more out of the extra optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Add 5% warmup to the depth-8 / batch-262k config to stabilize early training with the increased step count.
